Few phones have been more anticipated than a foldable iPhone, but it’s finally here. The iPhone Duo was unveiled during Apple’s “Surprise and shine” event alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 models.

Apple’s first foldable has a 5.4-inch outer screen, and it unfolds to show off its 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR screen. Apple Pencil support is coming later this year. While it lacks Face ID for facial unlocking, there’s a Touch ID sensor along its edge to identify your fingerprint. The device has an IP68 rating, with Ceramic Shield 2 on its back, with Ceramic Shield covering the front display. It has the same A20 Pro chipset as the iPhone 18 Pro. Notably, the Duo has the same 48-megapixel fusion camera as the 18 Pro, though it doesn’t have variable aperture.

The foldable will come in two colors, Star White and Night Sky, and starts at $1,999 for the 256GB version. You can preorder an unlocked version now ahead of its Friday, October 23rd release date from Apple and Best Buy.

iPhone Duo

Offers from carriers

If you’re looking to buy from a carrier, a few are offering promomtions.

  • AT&T is offering new and existing customers up to $1,200 off the iPhone Duo with a qualifying trade-in, applied through 36 monthly bill credits. Customers switching to AT&T can also receive up to $800 via a reward card to help pay off their existing phone balance. Additionally, customers who activate a new eligible line online can save up to $200 per line through 36 monthly bill credits.
  • T-Mobile will offer up to $1,000 off the iPhone Duo with eligible trade-ins on an Experience Beyond or Go5G Next plan. Alternatively, you can get the same discount without a trade-in when adding a new line and switching from another carrier.
  • Verizon is waiving its $40 activation fee for new customers who preorder the iPhone Duo. You can pay $55.55 per month over 36 months at 0 percent APR. Alternatively, Verizon offers a Simplicity Pro package for $72.22 per month, which bundles the phone with additional perks like two extra TravelPass days per month, and lets you upgrade your phone up to two times within a rolling 12-month period.
  • Sheena Vasani
